sqlite.name: alerts
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE alerts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	current_severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	highest_severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	trigger_telemetry_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	latest_telemetry_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	trigger_sequence_no BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	latest_sequence_no BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	trigger_depth_cm FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	latest_depth_cm FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	triggered_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_transition_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	resolved_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_source CHECK (source = 'sensor'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_severity CHECK (current_severity IN ('NORMAL', 'ADVISORY', 'WARNING', 'EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_highest_severity CHECK (highest_severity IN ('ADVISORY', 'WARNING', 'EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_lifecycle CHECK ((status = 'ACTIVE' AND current_severity <> 'NORMAL' AND resolved_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'RESOLVED' AND current_severity = 'NORMAL' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	UNIQUE (trigger_telemetry_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trigger_telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(latest_telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id)
)

sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE alert_transitions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	alert_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	telemetry_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence_no BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	previous_severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	new_severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	water_depth_cm FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	transitioned_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_transition_previous CHECK (previous_severity IN ('NORMAL', 'ADVISORY', 'WARNING', 'EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_transition_new CHECK (new_severity IN ('NORMAL', 'ADVISORY', 'WARNING', 'EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_transition_changed CHECK (previous_severity <> new_severity), 
	FOREIGN KEY(alert_id) REFERENCES alerts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	UNIQUE (telemetry_id),

postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE alerts (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	current_severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	highest_severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	trigger_telemetry_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	latest_telemetry_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	trigger_sequence_no BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	latest_sequence_no BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	trigger_depth_cm FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	latest_depth_cm FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	triggered_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_transition_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	resolved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_source CHECK (source = 'sensor'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_severity CHECK (current_severity IN ('NORMAL', 'ADVISORY', 'WARNING', 'EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_highest_severity CHECK (highest_severity IN ('ADVISORY', 'WARNING', 'EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_lifecycle CHECK ((status = 'ACTIVE' AND current_severity <> 'NORMAL' AND resolved_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'RESOLVED' AND current_severity = 'NORMAL' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	UNIQUE (trigger_telemetry_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trigger_telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(latest_telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id)
)

postgresql.name: hazard_decisions
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE hazard_decisions (
	telemetry_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	policy_version INTEGER, 
	observation_tier VARCHAR(20), 
	episode_tier VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	review_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (telemetry_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id)
)

postgresql.name: identity_mail
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE identity_mail (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	action_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	recipient VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, 
	body_ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(action_hash) REFERENCES identity_actions (token_hash)
)

postgresql.name: resource_revisions
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE resource_revisions (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	resource_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_resource_revision UNIQUE (resource_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES response_resources (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

postgresql.name: sos_drill_responses
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE sos_drill_responses (
	sos_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	policy JSON NOT NULL, 
	coordinator_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	assigned_to INTEGER, 
	phase VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	attention VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	due_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	attempted_users JSON NOT NULL, 
	incident_id BIGINT, 
	closure_reason VARCHAR(40), 
	PRIMARY KEY (sos_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sos_id) REFERENCES sos_requests (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(coordinator_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assigned_to) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(incident_id) REFERENCES sos_drill_incidents (id)
)

postgresql.name: sos_response_events
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE sos_response_events (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	sos_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	request_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id INTEGER, 
	actor_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	details JSON NOT NULL, 
	resident_message VARCHAR(400) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_sos_response_event_version UNIQUE (sos_id, request_version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sos_id) REFERENCES sos_requests (id)
)

postgresql.name: station_credentials
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE station_credentials (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	identity_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	transport VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_station_credential_transport CHECK (transport IN ('http', 'mqtt', 'both')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES station_identities (station_id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

postgresql.name: station_ingress_budgets
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE station_ingress_budgets (
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	channel VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	window_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (station_id, channel), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES station_identities (station_id)
)

postgresql.name: station_telemetry_state
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE station_telemetry_state (
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	config_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	boot_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	boot_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sequence_no BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	device_uptime_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	measured_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	latest_telemetry_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (station_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(latest_telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id)
)

postgresql.name: alert_transitions
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE alert_transitions (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	alert_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	telemetry_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sequence_no BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	previous_severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	new_severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	water_depth_cm FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	transitioned_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_transition_previous CHECK (previous_severity IN ('NORMAL', 'ADVISORY', 'WARNING', 'EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_transition_new CHECK (new_severity IN ('NORMAL', 'ADVISORY', 'WARNING', 'EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_transition_changed CHECK (previous_severity <> new_severity), 
	FOREIGN KEY(alert_id) REFERENCES alerts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	UNIQUE (telemetry_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id)
)

indexes.name: ix_alert_transition_history
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_alert_transition_history ON alert_transitions (alert_id, id)

postgresql.name: exercise_telemetry
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE exercise_telemetry (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	config_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	boot_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	boot_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sequence_no BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	measured_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	credential_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	ingress_transport VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	ingress_identity VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_class VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_exercise_boot_sequence UNIQUE (station_id, config_version, boot_id, sequence_no), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(credential_id) REFERENCES station_credentials (id)
)

postgresql.name: telemetry_provenance
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE telemetry_provenance (
	telemetry_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	credential_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	ingress_transport VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	ingress_identity VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_class VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	stream VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	registry_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (telemetry_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(credential_id) REFERENCES station_credentials (id)
)

postgresql.name: notification_events
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_events (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	transition_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	notification_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (transition_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(transition_id) REFERENCES alert_transitions (id)
)

postgresql.name: citywide_dispatches
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE citywide_dispatches (
	event_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	authority_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES notification_events (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(authority_id) REFERENCES alert_authorities (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

postgresql.name: notification_audiences
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_audiences (
	event_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	area_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES notification_events (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id)
)

postgresql.name: notification_deliveries
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_deliveries (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	event_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	device_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	result_category VARCHAR(40), 
	provider_mode VARCHAR(20), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	attempted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	next_attempt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_notification_event_device UNIQUE (event_id, device_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_notification_delivery_state CHECK (state IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'SENT', 'FAILED', 'SUPPRESSED', 'TESTED', 'UNKNOWN')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES notification_events (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES notification_devices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

indexes.name: ix_notification_pending
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_notification_pending ON notification_deliveries (state, next_attempt_at)

postgresql.name: station_delivery_gates
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE station_delivery_gates (
	event_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	notification_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	external_allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	lifecycle_state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES notification_events (id)
)

postgresql.name: notification_recipients
postgresql.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_recipients (
	delivery_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	subscription_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	area_binding_revision INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (delivery_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(delivery_id) REFERENCES notification_deliveries (id)
)
